title: Fabric Atelier: Material Energy Workshop
description: A virtual fabric atelier where a SpecularSilkPouf and Corset share a finite pool of 100 'material energy' units governing their visual properties. The user redistributes energy across shininess, color saturation, scale, and emissive glow for both objects while obeying conservation—total energy must always equal 100. Full undo/redo history tracks every adjustment.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load SpecularSilkPouf.glb on the left and Corset.glb on the right of a softly lit stage with a neutral gradient background. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,1.2,3.5) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Add an AmbientLight(0xffffff,0.4) and two DirectionalLights from upper-left and upper-right.

Implement a conservation system: a global pool of exactly 100 energy units. Each object has 4 channels—Shininess (mapped to MeshStandardMaterial roughness inversely, 0-25 units), Saturation (HSL saturation of base color, 0-25 units), Scale (uniform scale 0.5x–2.0x mapped from 0-25 units), and Emissive Glow (emissive intensity 0–1 mapped from 0-25 units). Display 8 labeled range sliders in an HTML overlay panel (4 per object, grouped). Show a live 'Energy Remaining' counter. When a slider changes, clamp so total across all 8 channels never exceeds 100; if it would, auto-reduce that slider to the max allowed. Apply changes in real-time to materials and transforms.

Implement a coupling toggle button: when enabled, adjusting any channel on one object mirrors the inverse change on the same channel of the other object (increasing Pouf shininess decreases Corset shininess by the same amount), preserving total energy.

Implement undo/redo: store snapshots of all 8 values on every slider commit (mouseup/touchend). Provide Undo and Redo buttons (and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z). A 'Reset' button restores the initial state (energy evenly split: 6 per channel, 2 remainder to Pouf Shininess and Corset Shininess). Show step counter 'Step X of Y'. The task requires 10-14 deliberate interactions to explore redistribution, coupling, undo, and redo. Render at 60fps with requestAnimationFrame.
